likeness.reason: Reads as a small car from the corner; the cabin is too tall for its length.

surface.reason: Studs on every top face, the bonnet a staircase of plates.

colour.reason: Red body, black wheels, trans windows; large flat red sides.

technique.reason: Everything studs up; no SNOT, no curved slopes.

buildability.reason: Opens whole, one piece, stands, no fault named.
